author: reek
body: Universal game registry. Any game - CodexMagic, chess, checkers, a clan's custom format, a third-party card game - can be registered with the platform. A registered game has an identity, a result type, and a protocol for resolving outcomes.

author: reek
body: This enables Shahrazad-as-abstraction: "pause this game, play a subgame of [registered game], winner gets [effect]." The subgame can be anything. Richard Garfield as he intended it, but over the entire space of games, not just one.
